questions.question_text: What is the typical duration for the Reading section in the PTE Academic test?
questions.explanation: According to the test format details for PTE Academic, the Reading section is designed to be completed in 22 to 30 minutes.

questions.question_text: How many question types are typically found in the Reading section of the PTE exam?
questions.explanation: The official test format documentation states that the Reading section consists of 5 different question types.

questions.question_text: What does the PTE Reading section specifically assess?
questions.explanation: The Reading section is specifically dedicated to evaluating a candidate's reading ability using five distinct types of questions.

questions.question_text: How many question types are in the Reading section?
questions.explanation: The Reading section of the PTE Academic test consists of 5 question types.

questions.question_text: What is the approximate duration of the Reading section?
questions.explanation: The Reading section in PTE Academic is timed to take between 22 and 30 minutes.

questions.question_text: What does the Reading section primarily assess?
questions.explanation: The Reading section is designed to test your ability to read and understand academic English texts.

questions.question_text: Which browser is recommended for taking the practice tests?
questions.explanation: Pearson recommends using Google Chrome or Firefox for the best performance on their platforms.

questions.question_text: Are the question types in PTE Core the same as in PTE Academic?
options: Yes, only for the Reading section
No, PTE Core has no Reading section
questions.explanation: PTE Core uses everyday English content, whereas PTE Academic uses academic English content.

questions.question_text: How long is a PTE score report valid for?
questions.explanation: PTE scores are valid for a period of two years from the date of the test.

questions.question_text: Can you take a PTE test from your home?
options: Yes, if you have a camera
No, it must be at a test center
No, unless you live in Canada
questions.explanation: All official PTE tests must be taken at an authorized test center to ensure security and reliability.

questions.question_text: How are results shared with institutions?
questions.explanation: PTE scores are digital and can be shared securely with institutions for free via your myPTE account.

questions.question_text: What is the typical time frame to receive PTE results?
questions.explanation: Most test takers receive their results typically within 48 hours (two business days) of the test.

questions.question_text: If you fail the Reading section in a Practice Test, what should you do?
options: Use the Score Report to identify areas for improvement
questions.explanation: The Score Report provides a breakdown of performance, which helps you focus your study on specific weaknesses.
